app.title: Image Replace
app.description: Local OCR text detection and replacement in images.

demo.panelDescription: Processing is local and deterministic. Inputs stay separate from user data and are not sent to external services.
demo.error: The scenario could not be run.
demo.scenarioDescription: Count the words and characters in synthetic text.
demo.sampleFileContent:
Synthetic file created in memory.
No business or client data.

home.title: Text detection and replacement
home.subtitle: Analyze an image locally, find references, and replace them when needed.

image.selectionHint: Only checked pairs will be applied. Each run uses the latest image, including brush edits. Uncheck completed pairs to continue with other references.
image.imageTypes: PNG, JPG, WEBP, BMP, or TIFF · 15 MB maximum
image.excelMergeHint: Pairs found in the workbook are shown and editable below; they are combined with manually entered pairs.
image.emptyExcelPairs: No pairs were found for this part.
image.noPieces: No name was found in the part column where the selected reference column is blank.
image.pieceRule: A part heading is a row where the selected reference column is blank and the part column contains a name; pairs are read until the next heading.
image.pairHint: Spaces and punctuation are ignored; matching regions are covered in white before replacement.
image.modelDownloadHint: OCR models may download on first use. Inference then runs locally.
image.emptyPreviewDescription: Add an image, then run OCR analysis.
image.wheelZoom: Scroll to zoom · drag to pan
image.lamaHint: Paint over the area to remove; LaMa reconstructs the background.
image.colorHint: Paint over the area to remove; the median color around the selection covers it.
image.errorImageSize: The image exceeds the 15 MB limit.
image.errorExcelSize: The workbook exceeds the 15 MB limit.
image.errorPairIncomplete: Each pair must include a reference and a replacement.
image.errorExcelSelection: Finish selecting the Excel sheet, columns, and part.
image.errorPrepareImage: Unable to prepare the image for filling.
image.errorReadSelection: Unable to read the brush selection.
image.errorSelectionSize: The selection does not match the image dimensions.
image.errorDetectColor: Unable to detect the color around the selection.
image.errorMask: Unable to prepare the brush mask.
